prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1108; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for them. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide a certified copy of the policy declarations page, including the bodily injury and property damage liability limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with a statement of any other coverage that may apply. Please also confirm whether the insured has reported the claim.

Finally, we request that you preserve all evidence relating to this loss. This includes photographs, vehicle data, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, repair estimates, and any dash camera or telematics information. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or deleted while the claim is pending. We look forward to your prompt written response.
